items_all.title: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium: September 19, 2026 — Steam Frame interview, killer AI models, and the DRAM crisis deepens
items_all.summary: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium, we offer deep-dives into the Steam Frame, explore how AI is changing the landscape of consumer electrionics, and how advanced AI accelerators are reaching Eastern shores, despite export controls.
items_all.title_original: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium: September 19, 2026 — Steam Frame interview, killer AI models, and the DRAM crisis deepens

items_all.title_bilingual: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium: September 19, 2026 — Steam Frame interview, killer AI models, and the DRAM crisis deepens
items_all.summary_zh: 本周，在 Tom's Hardware Premium 上，我们将深入探讨 Steam Frame，探索人工智能如何改变消费电子产品的格局，以及先进的人工智能加速器如何在出口管制的情况下到达东部海岸。

items_all.title: Fully custom copper PC features upcycled blowtorch reservoir — antique wooden pedestal complements steampunk design hiding a Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RX 9070 XT
items_all.summary: If Edison and Stephenson had teamed up to build a gaming PC, it might have looked like this custom copper and wood all-AMD design.
items_all.title_original: Fully custom copper PC features upcycled blowtorch reservoir — antique wooden pedestal complements steampunk design hiding a Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RX 9070 XT

items_all.title_bilingual: Fully custom copper PC features upcycled blowtorch reservoir — antique wooden pedestal complements steampunk design hiding a Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RX 9070 XT
items_all.summary_zh: 如果爱迪生和史蒂芬森联手打造一台游戏 PC，它可能看起来像这种定制的铜和木材全 AMD 设计。

items_all.title: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade
items_all.summary: Elon Musk's Terafab semiconductor project has run into an unexpected trademark dispute with Tera-print, a small U.S. company that has used the Tera-Fab name for its tabletop lithography equipment for about a decade.
items_all.title_original: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade
items_all.title_en: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade
items_all.title_bilingual: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade
items_all.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 Terafab 半导体项目与 Tera-print 发生了一场意想不到的商标纠纷，Tera-print 是一家美国小公司，该公司在其桌面光刻设备上使用 Tera-Fab 名称已有大约十年的时间。

items_all.title: Intel suspends bug bounty program that paid up to $100,000 per flaw — new Intigriti disclosure program offers no rewards
items_all.summary: Intel’s bug bounty program on Intigriti now shows as suspended, and a new Intel disclosure program there pays no bounties.
items_all.title_original: Intel suspends bug bounty program that paid up to $100,000 per flaw — new Intigriti disclosure program offers no rewards
items_all.title_en: Intel suspends bug bounty program that paid up to $100,000 per flaw — new Intigriti disclosure program offers no rewards
items_all.title_bilingual: Intel suspends bug bounty program that paid up to $100,000 per flaw — new Intigriti disclosure program offers no rewards
items_all.summary_zh: 英特尔在 Intigriti 上的错误赏金计划现已暂停，并且新的英特尔披露计划不支付任何赏金。

items_all.title: Enthusiast digs into CPU substrate for surgery to replace ripped-off data pin — resurrected chip boots and hits 33% overclock
items_all.summary: An Intel Celeron 1200 (Tualatin) was revived from the dead after a ripped-off pin was successfully replaced.
items_all.title_original: Enthusiast digs into CPU substrate for surgery to replace ripped-off data pin — resurrected chip boots and hits 33% overclock

items_all.title_bilingual: Enthusiast digs into CPU substrate for surgery to replace ripped-off data pin — resurrected chip boots and hits 33% overclock
items_all.summary_zh: 成功更换一根脱落的插针后，一台 Intel Celeron 1200 (Tualatin) 起死回生。
